name: Martin Faergemann
headline: Regional Sales Director Channel, Western Europe at Oracle NetSuite
about:
Hello, thank you for taking the time to view my profile. Working with customers over the past 16 years, in partnership with Solution Providers, I am enthusiastic about helping businesses gain competitive advantage through the adoption of cloud business management solutions.

I offer:

• Wholesale Distribution, Software & Services, Not For Profit vertical expertise 
• ERP, CRM, PSA and ecommerce cloud technology knowledge
• Channel Management

I am looking to hear from companies who want to revolutionize their business through technology.

I am married with 3 sons, enjoy the gym, travelling, windsurfing and cooking.
